components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Square high-signal action for installation and primary navigation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:48px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:0; padding:12px 16px; color:#04130c; background:#57ef97; font:700 14px/1.4 Archivo,sans-serif; transition:background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#9cffc2; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #57ef97; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Square outlined action for documentation and alternate paths.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height:48px; border:1px solid #668575; border-radius:0; padding:12px 16px; color:#f7fff9; background:transparent; font:700 14px/1.4 Archivo,sans-serif; transition:border-color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color:#57ef97; background:#101512; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #57ef97; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Query Tabs
components.description: Square controls that switch between operational query presets.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); border:1px solid #2c3a32; border-radius:0; background:#030605; } .ds-tabs button { min-height:46px; border:0; border-right:1px solid #2c3a32; border-radius:0; color:#98aca2; background:transparent; font:650 11px/1.4 Archivo,sans-serif; } .ds-tabs button:last-child { border-right:0; } .ds-tabs button:hover { color:#f2faf6; background:#0b120e; } .ds-tabs button.active { color:#9cffc2; background:#0d2318; box-shadow:inset 0 -2px #9cffc2; } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #57ef97; outline-offset:-2px; }

components.name: Terminal Window
components.description: Square black surface for commands and plan diagnostics.
components.css: .ds-terminal { overflow:hidden; border:1px solid #2c3a32; border-radius:0; color:#f2faf6; background:#030605; box-shadow:0 30px 80px -44px rgb(0 0 0 / .94); font-family:'Fragment Mono',monospace; } .ds-terminal-bar { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr; align-items:center; min-height:46px; padding:0 16px; border-bottom:1px solid #2c3a32; color:#98aca2; font-size:10px; } .ds-terminal-bar b { justify-self:end; color:#9cffc2; font-weight:400; } .ds-terminal .dots { display:flex; gap:6px; } .ds-terminal .dots i { width:7px; height:7px; background:#ffb32d; } .ds-terminal .dots i:nth-child(2) { background:#c9ff55; } .ds-terminal .dots i:nth-child(3) { background:#57ef97; } .ds-terminal > code { display:block; padding:18px 16px; color:#c8dbd3; font-size:11px; }

components.name: Benchmark Row
components.description: Measured comparison row with tool, bar, and exact timing.
components.css: .ds-bench { display:grid; grid-template-columns:130px 1fr 80px; align-items:center; gap:16px; min-height:60px; color:#d4e4da; font-family:Archivo,sans-serif; } .ds-bench strong { font-size:13px; } .ds-bench .track { height:18px; border-left:1px solid #668575; background:linear-gradient(to right,#2a362f 1px,transparent 1px); background-size:20% 100%; } .ds-bench .track i { display:block; width:12%; height:100%; background:linear-gradient(90deg,#57ef97,#c9ff55); } .ds-bench output { color:#57ef97; font:11px 'Fragment Mono',monospace; text-align:right; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Compact square navigation bar with search and theme control.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; min-height:56px; align-items:center; gap:24px; border-bottom:1px solid #2a362f; border-radius:0; padding:0 24px; color:#f7fff9; background:#080b09; font:600 13px/1.4 Archivo,sans-serif; } .ds-nav strong { margin-right:auto; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:#57ef97; } .ds-nav button { min-height:36px; border:1px solid #2a362f; border-radius:0; padding:0 14px; color:#a6b8ad; background:transparent; } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #57ef97; outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: Branchcut looks like an instrument for understanding work that has already happened: a query enters one side, a filesystem tree moves through the middle, and measured evidence leaves the other. The interface is square, direct, and information-dense without feeling cramped. It should feel alert and engineered, not like a generic developer-tool dashboard. Dark surfaces are the default because the page is often open beside a terminal, but the palette avoids a single muddy green field. Neutral near-black establishes focus; luminous mint identifies the selected route; chartreuse marks decisive evidence; cyan separates comparison tools; orange marks pruned work.
keyCharacteristics: Graph-paper structure tied to filesystem traversal.
Dark-first surfaces with high-energy signal colors.
Honest data visualization and visible system boundaries.
Monospace reserved for commands, paths, and measurements.

rules.name: The Functional Signal Rule
rules.body: Green means Branchcut or a viable path. Cyan means another measured tool. Amber means work removed or requiring attention. Do not reuse those colors decoratively.

rules.name: The Signal Type Rule
rules.body: Use monospace when the text is code, a filesystem path, a unit, a version, or measured data. Never use it to imitate technical atmosphere.

rules.name: The Hard Rule Rule
rules.body: A visible section boundary uses a 1px rule. Do not replace it with a shadow or a rounded container.

dos: Do keep every corner at 0px, including dialogs, inputs, tabs, and badges.
Do use color as a functional signal and preserve the green-cyan-amber distinctions.
Do label synthetic traversal geometry and workload-specific benchmarks explicitly.
Do use visible rules and grid intersections to structure the page.
Do keep keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior visible and complete.
donts: Don't tint every dark surface with green; neutral darkness provides the contrast the signal colors require.
Don't add pill buttons, rounded cards, glow halos, or soft corners.
Don't use gradients outside measured data visualization.
Don't introduce a second icon family or a stronger display typeface.
Don't turn plan data into unsupported product claims.
